Location: On a cliff overlooking Deleyn's Mill
Quote: Well this is picturesque, eh? Aside from all the imps and such. Did you know that imps have belly-buttons? Please don't ask me why!

Location: Between the roots on the north side of the Beldama Wyrd Tree
Quote: Another breach near that tree, I think. Fun fact-all deciduous trees love accordion music. Just more proof that all trees are idiots.

Location: On a bluff on the west side of Burial Mounds
Quote: Ugh … zombies. You ever try to talk to a zombie? They won't let you get a word in edgewise! Just groan this and moan that! Let's find this breach and leave, eh?

Location: Inside a shipwreck on the west side of the Koeglin Lighthouse island
Quote: Another breach by the sea! Ship's seen better days, eh? It's like I always say-the only thing you should make out of wood is nothing. Wood is ridiculous.

Location: On the edge of the highest tier of Cumberland Falls
Quote: Hmm …. I'm seeing a breach by a waterfall. Or maybe a flight of very wet stairs. Stairs are a bit silly, eh? Why not flip gravity and fall up?
Definitely a breach here, mate. Say, I was thinking-maybe we should get something for Josajeh to cheer her up! I'm thinking meat of some variety. You meat-brains like meat, right?

Location: On the edge of a cliff north of Salas En, northeast of The Warrior, overlooking Rain Catcher Fields
Quote: You're doing that thing where water squirts out of your skin, aren't you? Sweating, eh? Ugh. And you people think I'm weird! Let's find this breach and cool off.

Location: Against a cliff wall west of Easterly Aerie
Quote: Hmm …. Yeah, there's a breach nearby. Say, did you know there are six and a half quadrillion grains of sand in the Alik'r? Oh, come on. Don't act like you're not impressed!
Ah, look! Yokudan ruins. You know the Yokudans could make magic idea-swords using nothing but their brains? Bit of a waste, that. I'd have made a very comfortable chair.
